column1: # Lexeme class `time_noun`: nouns that name a point or span of time (docs/LEXICON_FORMAT.md §14
# Values: weekday, month, holiday, unit (calendar and clock units), daytime, season,
#   phase (beginning, middle, end of a span), period (historical or life periods),
#   span (general words for a stretch or point of time).
# Written from own knowledge of German (clean-room); only lemmas of this lexicon.
